annotations.title: Walkable spaces in AREMES HQ and the RSMAD museum

description: Every walkable 3D space by the artist Ryan Seslow: the floors and rooms of AREMES HQ in Brooklyn, the twelve galleries of RSMAD (the Ryan Seslow Museum of Art & Design), the Sculpture Park, the street outside, and the other AREMES buildings on it: Commercial, Residential, the Yard, Robot Works, Cutting & Finishing, and Art Production with its sculpture garden. Each opens in any web browser, on a phone or in a VR headset. Returns name, link, description, floor and access (most are free).

query.description: Optional words to filter by name or description, e.g. "museum", "vaults", "third floor".
